name: Back to top with progress scrollbar
description: Provides a 'back to top' block with a circular scroll-progress indicator.
package: Back to top with progress scrollbar
project_description: The Back to top with progress scrollbar module provides a Drupal block rendering a smooth 'back to top' button ringed by a circular SVG progress indicator that fills as the visitor scrolls down the page. The block is a single Block plugin (BackToTopBlock) whose per-placement configuration form exposes colors (circle stroke, box shadow, icon, icon hover, fill), a left/right position, an optional drop shadow, an optional fill color, and a display mode (arrow icon or scroll percentage). Rendering is driven by the 'back_to_top_with_pi' theme hook and templates/back-to-top-with-pi.html.twig; a jQuery behavior in js/custom.js computes SVG path progress on scroll, animates a smooth scroll to top on click, and (in percentage mode) writes the live percentage into a data attribute. The unicons CSS icon font supplies the arrow glyph. The Twig template can be copied into a theme to customize the markup. No routes, permissions, services, config schema, or install hooks; the only dependency is core Block.
